note: Brief 109 round 4 (Aster: Sky on 0.2.330 by day, "got flicker here on the curb and top here"): the kerb by the square's planter and the flat roof across the road (the posts with green caps, the fountain dome), at play zoom 10, view step 2. Still: the kerb's contact strip on the lens (both 4 mm up: a depth fight, a fixed pattern while the camera rests). Moving: the camera follows the getaway out after the Go over the zone's roofs, so the stand-off eases as the frame passes roofs of other heights (PlayStandOff) and the one shadow cascade refits each frame; shadow edges crawl. Before 0.2.330, after the build with ContactShade's lift (12 mm) and TacticalShadows' held fit depth. Both -juice on.
